_about: be•do V53 facts: choice strings, glyphs, orders and thresholds that hold nothing personal. Read at run time by the core and the builders; a chat reads it instead of recalling a string. Personal values (base ids, field ids, names) live in facts_local.json, gitignored; facts_local.example.json is its blank shape. Select strings were copied from the live schema, 4 Oct 2026. Change a string here only after the base changed, never before.

key.about: YYMMDD_HHMM of the first entry, a letter on collision. Only ⚡ action rows with an action status carry one.

clock.about: Every stream datetime is stored UTC with a Z; the local offset comes from facts_local, checked against the time zone on the day (I12).

flows.order_source: the practices catalog's order field, filtered to active; never recited
flows.about_either_or: 8 Oct 2026, her words: evening breaths are an either-or on the meditation. One logged closes both; the other is never asked for.
flows.about_sequences: Her stated orders, which beat any observed median. 4 Oct 2026: morning movement is early, with the coffee (easy waking-up movements); morning sun comes before the exercise block (hips, strength, breaths); water after the first coffee. Within the block the observed times decide. Dusk is ordered by clock time.
flows.about_core: A228, 2 Oct 2026, as the one line (20 Oct): the core is named; every other remaining step is its glyph after also:. Nothing leaves the catalog and everything counts toward done. The dusk core is not set yet (null prints every step as core).

about_widget: The remaining list is never a widget (7, 8, 11 and 20 Oct 2026): it is one horizontal code line. The two bar colours stay, for the day behind. A237, 2 Oct 2026, had the pill strip: dawn's bar is #EFA038, the marigold she named for spirit; dusk's is #7B6FD6, the blue-violet of the ☑️ box — her words 4 Oct 2026: dusk should be more of a purple, something like ☑️.

dusk_audit.attention_rule: a row sharing minutes with another row is 🌓 partial: both are recorded in full, nothing is beaten out (9 Oct 2026). Otherwise a discrete session (an end datetime) is 🌕 full; a session written as time spent because it spanned gaps is 🌓 partial (A262)

self_check.attention_pool: ✅ done and ▶️ in motion ⚡ action chains with a real span in the window
self_check.people_pool: contact rows (face-to-face, video call, phone, text) with a person tagged

catalog_standings.about: be•do never sets a standing unasked; a reading item clear-inbox files is the one exception (stories, want)

meals._about: Her rules, 7 Oct 2026 (the meals amendment): an educated guess, not a hard rule, and the onus is on be•do, not on her logging every minute. be•do places each meal's prep and eating from context, writes them ESTIMATED FROM CONTEXT, and tells her what went in the record so she can say if it is accurate.

prep_why.simple: a simple meal she made, like a sandwich
prep_why.straightforward: a really straightforward dinner she cooked
prep_why.cooked: a dinner she cooked; most take 45 minutes to an hour

meals.about_family_words: A meal in a family possessive (Mom's cornbread) was made by them, not ordered and not hers to prep: the eating is placed, no prep row is proposed (8 Oct).

fill._about: Rule 1 of the 9 Oct amendment, in code (the fill_gaps rules): every row is written with device and wellness, deduced at write time. Wellness: an ⚡ action on a drive takes the drive's element, else the practice's catalog wellness. Device: body and self-care practices 🚫 none, phone practices 📱 phone, 💻 laptop when the title says so, 🚫 none inside a walking, driving, cycling or location span. What can't be deduced is asked, in the same reply, never left empty. Personal practices extend these lists in facts_local under fill.

forecast._about: 20 Oct 2026: a forecast is one stream row in her words, what she thinks will happen, its target the day it comes due. No score, no percentages. Every look behind lists the forecasts due in its window; she says in her own words how each turned out.

skills_schedule._about: 20 Oct 2026, her words: I have a lot of skills and I just need to standardize when they get run, so I don't have to remember them. Every skill has a set time, kept here, the one place a skill's timing lives; preflight reads it at each chat's first reply and names what is due.
sunday: the week look behind, once every day has its dayqa (bedo-week-look-behind)
the events calendar for the next two weeks, at the close (facts_local events_calendar)

calendar._about: 6 Oct 2026: every calendar write names its calendar and is read back before it's called done. 9 Oct 2026: every work event is purple, Google Calendar colorId 3 (Grape), her employer's colour. Her calendar ids, work parents and work words live in facts_local under calendar.

inbox._about: Her inbox rules, in code (bedo_inbox): an automatic keep (26 Oct: anything from her husband is important, like a star) always gets a line on the one list and is never archived; a sender archived by default (25 Oct: a club's mail, a keep only when it's about what she cares about there); and before anything is archived she gets one line to glance through the inbox herself, and archiving waits for her go (22 Oct). The senders live in facts_local under inbox.
inbox.nudge: give your inbox a quick look before I archive the rest — {n} thread(s) · {link}

open_actions._about: 8 Oct 2026, her words: hey, I'm on my phone and I have a few minutes, what are some quickie tasks. Every new ⬜ ▶️ ▫️ action row is written with the device it will be done on, deduced like wellness; she corrects, she never fills it in. The quickie box is judgment (J12).

buckets._about: 20 Oct 2026, her words: everything should fit either under a rhythm or a drive. A flow practice belongs to its flow and carries no rhythm; every other row that happened carries a rhythm or a drive, deduced like wellness, corrected in passing. Stories, read or watched, are her stories rhythm (facts_local stories_rhythm); a window chat's rows and captures are the system drive (facts_local system_rhythm, 26 Oct guideline).

being_doing._about: 24 Oct 2026, her words: passively laying on the couch and watching a show is not doing much. An ⚡ action on a drive or rhythm takes that bucket's element (doing), never a being area by default; passive rest takes a being area, 🩷 heart with people, else what she says.

appointments._about: 6 Oct 2026, her words: when I share an appointment like that, I need you to add it to the calendar. A row for an appointment still ahead carries its calendar event link; a to-do to book one is not the appointment.

cloudy._about: 28 Oct 2026, her words: the weather excuse isn't great … I think I need to use other blue light in the AM if it's cloudy. I already have a good blue light: my mirror, very bright, very natural colored. Replaces the 26 Oct weather status. A cloudy morning keeps 🔅 morning sun due by the same sun-by time, and the bright light is how it's met: logged ◉ done with the light in her words, never ⨂ skipped for the weather. The light's name is hers, facts_local cloudy_light.

entry_rules._about: The 9 Oct amendment, rules 2 and 6, and the 8 Oct one that every row carries a practice. A row's datetime and end fall on one local day and span at most max_span_hours; closing an old chain row sets its datetime to the act, never a multi-day span from its first date. A night's sleep is the one row that crosses midnight. person is for people she was with or in direct contact with; a plan (▫️ ⬜) names them in mentioned until it happens.

dayqa._about: run_checks.sh dayqa DATE: meals, gaps, movement, people and device in one list. Every fill is ESTIMATED FROM CONTEXT and names its source; the dusk close shows it, writes only what she accepts, and carries the marker line in its [be•do] block. The look behind will not build a day whose rows don't carry the marker.

sources.usual: your usual, from your past weeks

dayqa.about_movement_words: Only words that mean movement whatever the sentence: 'run' and 'running' read as running the checks on 6 Oct.
dayqa.about_note_practices: A clue inside an unlogged stretch is a note of hers, a photo, a message or Oura. A routine tick logged as a moment (a coffee, phone charging) says nothing about the stretch around it: on 8 Oct a 3 a.m. phone-charging row would have filled four hours.

synergy._about: Her rule, 24 Aug 2026, and her words 9 Oct: when two things run at once, are they synergizing or competing? Four answers — synergizing (one plus one makes four), competing (one plus one makes one), both, neutral — and declining is always fine. The answer is a note, not a field: one line at the end of her words, 'overlap — synergizing with <key or title>'. be•do helps her notice: synergy, do more of that; competing, try them apart. Read from what she says about it first (27 Oct 2026, her words: I want the system to deduce synergy or competition from what I say about the event or action; it doesn't work to ask me about it after the fact), her own word, then the cues below. When her words don't say, it is asked in the moment, once, as she logs it — never a day late (her words: not that I never want to be asked, but when it's a day late I will have forgotten).
synergy.about_cues: Phrases that say how two things went together without her naming synergy or competition. Her own word wins; both kinds of cue in one row read as both.

say.competing: competing — next time, try them apart
say.both: some of each — notice which part helped
say.neutral: they just sat side by side

needs._about: Her build note, Sun 18 Oct 2026: the week look behind shows Maslow's deficiency vs. growth needs, tied to the secure base. The eight wellness areas pair (heart and water, mind and air, body and earth, spirit and fire); two pairs are the deficiency needs Maslow names first, two are the growth needs, and from a secure base the deficiency side is met so the growth side can open. A settings key 'needs' with the same shape overrides this.

deficiency.label: belonging and esteem
deficiency.says: love, belonging, the work that earns respect

growth.label: meaning and making
growth.says: self-actualisation, creating, what reaches past the self

garden._about: Her words, 19 Oct 2026: show and reflect meaning, the layers of a day like Garner. The week look behind draws each moment she marked as mattering as one flower: its petals are the areas the moment touched, a ring is a memory it echoes, a glow is a moment made more by sharing it (synergy). Areas come from the row's own wellness, the people on it (heart), and her words, read with the word lists below. Nothing is inferred beyond her words.
garden._photo_skip_practices: 22 Oct 2026: a photo taken for a routine row (a pill, a screen of scores) is the record of a check, not a picture of the day; the day page leaves it out. Someone else's meds are matched by photo_skip_pattern, not by name.
garden._kind_words: When a moment's own practice says only that it was logged or marked (a log, a highlight, a glimmer), the first of these whose words appear in its title names what the thing was; the mark stays as a badge.

photos._about: 25 Oct 2026, her words: two kinds of photo. Informational ones carry what a row needs (a meal, a pill, a screen) and are not important in themselves. Keepers are the moments she wants to capture and hold on to; they show on the look behind, day and week. The chat that logs a photo sets the row's photo field to one or the other; a row from before the field (the old checkbox) is sorted by rule.
photos._food_practices: Her rule, 25 Oct 2026: a picture of just food is info, hidden from the pages. It is a keeper when something about it is special: a restaurant or someone's table, people in it, or she said it was a spectacularly good meal. By rule (no kind set), a food row is a keeper when it names someone with her, or where it was (at …), or family.
photos._info_practices: A photo for one of these is the record of a check or a screen, not a picture of the day (garden.photo_skip_practices, 22 Oct, and the screens and flyers read since).
photos._match: At dusk a photo row with no link takes the folder file taken nearest before the row's time, at most 90 minutes before or 5 after: a photo is shared after it is taken, rarely before.
